neighbours.label: a judgment that something fails or cannot do what is expected (X is useless if..., studies can't show...), as against the same subject described as working
fire: A firewall is useless if every port is left open to the internet.
Survey data can't prove that the drug caused the recovery, only that they co-occur.
A backup is useless if nobody has ever tested restoring it.
Animal studies can't show that the effect holds in humans, only in mice.
A smoke alarm is useless if the battery has been taken out.
Small samples can't show whether the trend is real, only hint at it.
Two-factor login is useless if the codes are sent to the same laptop.
A map is useless if the roads have changed since it was printed.
quiet: A firewall filters traffic between the office and the internet.
Survey data was collected from twelve hospitals across the region.
A backup is copied to a second building every night.
Animal studies were run in two labs over three years.
A smoke alarm is fitted in every bedroom of the house.
Small samples were taken from each lake in the spring.
Two-factor login sends a code to the user's phone.
A map of the old town hangs in the hotel lobby.
